course.title: Coastal and Special Zones Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Determine annual soil (silt loam) loss from an upland farm of 650 acres in Khulna (Rainfall Erosivity Factor is 250). The slope length is 300 feet with 3 percent slope steepness (topographic factor is 0.4). The soil is covered with matured grass (0.004) and relative erodibilities of silt loam soil is 0.33. If slope steepness increases to 5 percent (topographic factor is 0.928), find the changes in soil erosion.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2014
